headings.strategy: Swiss Brutalist - sharp, strong, brutally honest. High weight contrast (Black for verdicts, Medium for section headers). Tight tracking.

body.strategy: Functional, clean readability for long analytical text.

data_and_scores.strategy: Used for all metrics, scores, risk levels, and analytical data to emphasize the 'AI research tool' aesthetic.

colors.strategy: Dark developer/founder-tool aesthetic. The primary color (#014644) is used for brand accents, active states, and primary CTAs. Backgrounds are deep tinted grays (not pure black). Do not overuse gradients; rely on flat colors and subtle 1px borders.

visual enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders using the 'Technical Look' pattern. Use `border-white/10` or `#1A2626`.
visual enhancers.shadows: Very subtle ambient shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-inner`). No glowing neon unless it's a critical alert.
visual enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain overlay across the app background to kill digital flatness and enhance the 'research tool' feel.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism globally. Use solid dark surfaces to maintain the serious, brutalist analytical feel. The only exception is the sticky navigation bar, which can have a slight blur (`backdrop-blur-md bg-[#060909]/80`). DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds.

grids.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B: High Density). Base: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12`. Very tight gaps (`gap-4` or `gap-6`).
grids.factor_analysis_grid: 8-factor grid using `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`. All items must stretch to equal height.
grids.brutal_reality_section: List format or 1-column strict vertical stack with red/amber/green dot indicators.

layouts.landing: Center-aligned hero content with a brutalist typography focus, followed by a 'preview' container showing a mock report.
layouts.input_form: Max-width centered container (`max-w-2xl`). Clean, minimal, focusing entirely on the idea input.
layouts.results_dashboard: Max-width container (`max-w-6xl`). Contains a sticky sub-navigation, hero score area, and then structured dense bento grids for the analysis.
layouts.prototype_badge: Fixed bottom-right unobtrusive badge with text 'Prototype / Demo Analysis' to prevent hallucination concerns.

motion.loading_analysis: 10-stage sequential text animation (e.g., 'Analyzing Market...', 'Checking Competitors...', 'Calculating Viability...'). Fast transitions (2-4s total).
motion.score_transition: Animated number counters for the Viability Score (especially in the 'Save The Idea' section where it transitions from 42 to 64).
motion.interactions: Fast, subtle micro-interactions on hover. Minimal scaling (`hover:scale-[1.01]`). Use `transition-colors duration-200`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over primary color #014644 meets APCA standards (usually requires white text).
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings. `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#014644] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#060909]`.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, forms, links, and key result cards.

media.strategy: No photography required. Rely heavily on typography, shapes, charts, and icons (Phosphor or Lucide).

3d_libraries.recommendation: None. Keep the interface 2D, flat, and extremely fast to load, fitting the 'brutal reality' and 'linear' aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete fully working frontend prototype as a single-page app.
Implement the flow: Landing -> Input Form -> Loading Animation -> Results Dashboard.
The analysis results MUST BE HARDCODED or mock-generated on the frontend to reflect the 'Demo analysis' requirement. Do not build a real backend AI.
The scores should explicitly not be 100% positive. Force a 'High Risk' scenario (e.g., Viability Score 42/100).
Use standard Lucide React icons for the factor cards and risk indicators.
Build a custom radial score visualization using SVG or Recharts for the main verdict.
In the 'Can We Save This Idea?' section, implement an interactive button that triggers the simulated score improvement animation.
Write React components as .jsx/.js files, not .tsx. Do not use TypeScript syntax.
Ensure GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES are applied across all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters ONLY on the sticky nav.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
